units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 4:6">Nidd. IV, 6</cite> <he>דם הש׳</he> blood discharged in comfort (without travail), opp. <cite ref="S00667"><he>קושי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Niddah 37b:41">Ib. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>תרי בקושי וחד בש׳</he> twice with pain, and once in comfort; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:8:2">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵇ</cite> top <he>שתים בש׳ ואחת בקושי</he> (not <he>באושי</he>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. (play on <he>פ̇ישׁון</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:11">Gen. II, 11</cite>) <he>מימיו מהלכין בש׳</he> its waters run smoothly; Yalk. ib. 21.
<cite ref="Ketubot 20a">Keth. 20ᵃ</cite> when he has been enjoying the usufruct <he>שלש שנים ובש׳</he> for three years, and that in comfort (without protest by claimants); a. e.
